explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/107, the Erdős–Szekeres happy-ending conjecture f(n) = 2^{n-2} + 1 for n ≥ 3. f(n) is the infimum of the N such that every N-point set with no three collinear (NonTrilinear) contains n points in convex position (ConvexIndep: no point lies in the convex hull of the others). The relevant set of N is upward closed and nonempty by nonempty_cardSet, so the infimum is the intended minimum. It is correctly marked open. The `question` tag on a 'prove that' statement is cosmetic.
